name: Salimah Kassim-Lakha
reason: Health rule (borderline, so left out): her site yogavision.com (robots.txt allows us; contact form at /contact) presents her as a yoga therapist and frames nearly every offering around conditions and therapy: 'Kundalini Yoga for Nervous System Support', trauma counselling, healing childhood and generational trauma, and practices sold for anxiety, sleep, pain and menopause; her Kundalini teacher training, numerology sessions and membership are all pitched the same way, so the work reads as mainly therapeutic.
